description.narrative: The Malindi Solar Group will build a 52 MW solar photovoltaic power plant in South-East Kenya. Globeleq, our majority owned independent power producer solely focused on building more power generation in Africa, is the sponsor of the project. Malindi is on track to be the first of four utility-scale solar power plants in Kenya to begin construction.

sector.narrative: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

description.narrative: $31.9 million debt investment from BII and $16 million from Globeleq to finance the construction of a 52 MW solar photovoltaic power plant in South-East Kenya. As the mandated lead arranger, BII initially invested $51.9 million in debt financing before syndicating USD20m to DEG, the German development finance institution. The plant, operational since January 2022, is one of the first independent-owned utility scale solar plants in Kenya.
